claims.title: Forward response history compiles joint inverse questions without an energy potential

quoted_fields.interface: Stable forward full-vector source, Euclidean port semantics, independently justified m>0 and0<=a<m with the specific shifted residual bound. Exact native pairs for exact family claims; bounded measurement reports give only the stated outer envelopes. Unconstrained inverse acts on all R^d. Constrained VI additionally supplies a nonempty closed convex allowed set C, queries in C and an available metric projection.
quoted_fields.failure: This is narrower than all strongly monotone Lipschitz maps and does not infer an energy potential, a Hessian or the physical contract from finite readings. Exact joint inverse sharpness is over the global residual-Lipschitz class, not a smoother physical family. Sparse existence needs nonempty interior and at least one finite historical ball; chosen dyadic certificates may be loose. Noisy balls and VI balls are outer only. Actual four-program clean replay remains a source report; original studies were not executed here. No physical source, independent architecture advantage or priority acquired.
